findings.message: Track 2 has 7 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.message: <div id="endcard"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="endcard"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: <audio id="a_narr_end"> runs from 26s to 30.11s, past the root composition's data-duration of 30s, so it is cut off in previews, posters and renders.
findings.fixHint: Extend the root data-duration to 30.11, or make <audio id="a_narr_end"> end at or before 30s.

findings.message: Multiple audible <audio>/<video> elements on track 21 overlap (assets/sfx/icechunk_echo.wav at 10.49-12.99s, assets/sfx/icebreak_echo.wav at 12.5-16s). This causes layered audio playback.
